title: Pennine Brakes
summary: Component supplier receiving automated BACS disbursements, recorded with sort code 20-45-11 and account number 73319201 in payment run PR-20261022.
body:
Pennine Brakes is a supplier to Northbridge Cycles documented in accounts payable bank export records [^r1]. As of 26 October 2026, the company receives disbursements through automated bank payment runs processed via sort code 20-45-11 and account number 73319201 [^r1]. The supplier's most recent recorded transaction is payment run PR-20261022 for the amount of £18,734.40 on 22 October 2026 [^r1].

## Record

The vendor maintains bank account details consisting of sort code 20-45-11 and account number 73319201 [^r1]. Payment run PR-20261022 disbursed £18,734.40 to this account [^r1].
